paper: Notin et al., ProteinGym: Large-Scale Benchmarks for Protein Fitness Prediction and Design, NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks Track
paper_source: sources/neurips_Paper-Datasets_and_Benchmarks.pdf (49 pages, main text + appendix; proceedings.neurips.cc file cac723e5ff29f65e3fcbb0739ae91bee). No separate supplemental file exists on the proceedings site; the appendix is inside the paper PDF.

definitions.test_set: reference_files/DMS_substitutions.csv at PG_v1.3: 217 substitution assays, 2,465,767 mutants, 186 UniProt IDs, 16 targets with seq_len > 1022. Function types (coarse_selection_type): Activity 43, Binding 13, Expression 18, OrganismalFitness 77, Stability 66.
definitions.per_assay_metric: Spearman rank correlation between model score and DMS_score over all mutants of the assay (paper 4.1).
definitions.corrected_average_primary_literal: Paper A.5.1: average the per-assay Spearman over all assays of each of the 5 function types, then average the 5 numbers. Values from the authors' per-assay table: ESM-1b 0.3982, ESM2 8M 0.2244, 35M 0.3196, 150M 0.3895, 650M 0.4184.
definitions.corrected_average_secondary_code: performance_DMS_benchmarks.py at PG_v1.3: average assays per (UniProt_ID, function type), then average those per function type, then average the 5. Values: ESM-1b 0.3941, 8M 0.2257, 35M 0.3208, 150M 0.3868, 650M 0.4138. This reproduces all 5 paper values to the third decimal; the literal reading does not (ESM-1b 0.398 vs 0.394).
definitions.esm2_scoring: masked-marginals (paper A.4 text and scoring_ESM2_substitutions.sh agree); long sequences: --scoring-window default 'optimal' (single 1022-aa window chosen around each position).
definitions.esm1b_scoring: Ambiguous. Paper A.4 says masked-marginal for ESM models but also says long sequences follow Brandes et al. [2023] for ESM-1b; the released script uses wt-marginals with overlapping windows (repo issue #99). Primary run: the released script, unchanged. Literal 'masked-marginal' recorded as an alternative, not used.
definitions.checkpoints: esm1b_t33_650M_UR50S, esm2_t6_8M_UR50D, esm2_t12_35M_UR50D, esm2_t30_150M_UR50D, esm2_t33_650M_UR50D from dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/fair-esm/models/
definitions.tolerance_rule: 1 non-parametric bootstrap SE of the model's own corrected average, from the authors' per-assay values: 10,000 resamples of assays with replacement inside each function type, seed 0, literal definition, rounded to 3 decimals. The paper's own SE (Table A5) is the SE of the difference from the best model and does not fit this use.
